name: configs
description: Fleet config manager. Scans every module config.json across core/ and orbit/, gets/sets keys by dot-path with automatic timestamped backups, lints the fleet (invalid JSON, missing fields, name/dir mismatches, duplicate names, port collisions), and maps every claimed port. Ships a zero-dependency read-only web browser: config card grid with search, pretty JSON viewer, port map, and lint report.
